stemMd: Which inequality describes the closed disk of radius 3 centred at the origin?
explanationMd: Distance from the origin is the square root of x squared+y squared. Requiring it to be at most 3 gives x squared+y squared≤9, including interior and boundary.

distractorRationale.c: This is not a circular disk.
distractorRationale.d: This describes only the boundary circle.
distractorRationale.b: This describes the exterior including the boundary.
